summary: Live preview loads at 375x667 and backend contracts pass, but workspace creation remains blocked: after typing, the modal Save securely action is outside the viewport.

ui_bugs.issue: At the required 375x667 viewport, after filling the workspace input the keyboard/layout leaves Save securely outside the viewport; Playwright cannot tap it. This reproduces the prior blocker despite the KeyboardAvoidingView and ScrollView changes.

integration_issues.flow: Workspace -> account -> expense -> ledger -> spending -> sync
integration_issues.issue: Blocked at workspace save, so downstream flows could not be verified in this run.

issues: Primary action is not reliably tappable while the keyboard is active on the target mobile viewport.

action_items: Make the modal primary action reliably reachable while the keyboard is open at 375x667 (for example, ensure the sheet ScrollView scrolls the focused input/action into view). Add testIDs for modal input and Save securely controls, then retest the complete flow.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceProvider.sync uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while the requested environment contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; standardize or explicitly document this key across the app.
Sync failures and non-OK responses are silently ignored, leaving users without an error state or retry feedback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use one clean browser session at 375x667. App load passes and create-workspace opens. Filling Personal then tapping Save securely reproduces an outside-viewport failure. GET /api/ and POST /api/sync with [] pass.
rca_of_issue: The modal is bottom-aligned and its action remains below the visible mobile viewport when the TextInput is focused. The current keyboard-aware wrapper/ScrollView does not provide a reliable scroll-to-action behavior in Expo web at 375x667.
